name: revo-pawn
description: AMX Mod X / Pawn: formatting, IntelliSense, navigation and compiler diagnostics.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Editing and formatting work in Restricted Mode. Running the compiler requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Include resolution and the AMXX compiler need a local or remote file system.

revo_pawn.format.enable.description: Enable the Pawn document and selection formatter.

revo_pawn.format.braceStyle.description: Put block braces on their own lines, or preserve their original placement. Existing statement line breaks are always retained.

revo_pawn.format.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines outside protected text.

revo_pawn.format.insertFinalNewline.description: End formatted files with a newline.

revo_pawn.language.includePaths.description: Include directories shared by IntelliSense and the compiler. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${fileDirname}, ${env:NAME} and ~. Relative paths use the file's workspace folder.

revo_pawn.language.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum UTF-8 file size for parsing and formatting.

revo_pawn.language.maxIncludeFiles.description: Maximum files in one transitive include graph.

revo_pawn.language.webApiLinks.description: Link unresolved standard AMXX includes to the official API documentation.

revo_pawn.compiler.path.description: Full path to amxxpc or amxxpc.exe. Empty searches for the exact executable beside the source file.

revo_pawn.compiler.arguments.description: Additional compiler arguments, one per item. Passed directly without a shell. Input, output and include paths are managed by Revo Pawn.

revo_pawn.compiler.outputDirectory.description: Directory for compiled .amxx files. Created when compiling. Supports the same variables as includePaths.

revo_pawn.compiler.compileOnSave.description: Compile saved .sma files in trusted workspaces.

revo_pawn.compiler.showOutput.description: Reveal the output panel when compiling manually.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-build/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/test-integration.mjs
scripts.test:compiler: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/test-compiler.mjs
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build -- --production
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm test
